shared_elements: large blocky head with heavy brow ridge
schematic torso with arms held tight against the body
hands/arms converging toward the front of the abdomen
broad rectangular columnar body with no separated legs
justification: Both depict a single massive frontal anthropomorph as a rigid columnar block: oversized flat-browed head above a legless rectangular torso, with thin arms pressed to the sides and hands meeting low on the belly, and chest nipples indicated — a fairly specific shared scheme of body proportion and posture. They differ in surface treatment of the figure: A is covered with incised secondary iconography (headdress bands, pendant/disc ornaments, curved motifs and an encircled disc on the chest, a belt-like band), while B is plain and relies on sculpted volumes alone, and B's face shows carved nose and ear features absent in A's largely eroded/decorated head.
